name: THE LEDGE
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE CAMP BELOW
LOOK_AT: Fiddler's Gulch: tents, cabins, a river, and smoke going straight up. It looks rich from here.
Every man down there is standing in water or guarding something. Some are doing both.
I've come two days to stand on a ledge and look at other men's gold. It's like a shop window.
LISTEN_TO: Water, and shovels, and nobody talking.
A rocker going, slow, like a tired clock.
Somebody shouting 'MINE!' at somebody else, faintly.

overrides.TALK_TO: I shouted 'Hello!' down. A hundred men looked up, and one of them pointed a pan at me.

subjects.name: THE CAIRN
LOOK_AT: A heap of stones on the edge, piled on purpose.
A marker. For what, it doesn't say. Up here a man marks anything he might own later.
I added a stone. It seemed polite.
LISTEN_TO: Wind in the gaps between the stones.
Quiet. It isn't saying what it's for.

overrides.PUSH: Somebody built it carefully. I'm not going to be the man who undid it, on my first day.

subjects.name: THE RAVINE
LOOK_AT: The ravine wall, straight down. The path is the only sensible way down, and it isn't very.
I can see why nobody comes here. A hill has to fall on the road first.
A long way down. I've decided against finding out how long.
LISTEN_TO: The river, a long way below.
A pebble I kicked, still going.
Wind coming up the wall, cold.

overrides.USE: No. There's a path. I'll take the path.

subjects.name: THE MINE
LOOK_AT: The mine's far end, a hole in the cliff. It's the only door this town has.
Back through it are the slide, the road, and Grievance, eating.
From this side it's just a hole. You'd never know it had opinions about rocks.
LISTEN_TO: A drip, far back in the hill.

subjects.name: THE PATH DOWN
LOOK_AT: A path down the ravine wall, in zigzags, with a rope along the bad parts.
Somebody put the rope in. Somebody else, I think, needed it.
Every turn of it is in view of the camp. They'll see me coming for a quarter of an hour.
LISTEN_TO: The rope creaking against its pegs.
At the bottom, a man, waiting. I can hear him not moving.

overrides.PULL: I tested the rope. It held. I'd like that noted somewhere official.
